info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v4-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loan Refinances API provides users with comprehensive access to information about available mortgage loan refinancing options. This endpoint allows consumers, such as financial institutions and mortgage brokers, to query and retrieve detailed listings of refinance loans. By using this API, developers can integrate refinancing options into their applications, facilitating better decision-making for homeowners seeking to lower their mortgage payments. Typical use cases include comparing rates and terms to identify the most advantageous refinancing opportunities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve available options for refinancing their loans. By accessing this resource, users can explore various refinancing products and terms that best fit their financial needs.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refinance loan operation. This body should contain the necessary parameters required for processing the refinance request, structured in accordance with the defined schema.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: Request body for the GET operation on loans refinance, formatted as a JSON string.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.title: Refinance Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the refinance operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the refinance operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the refinance operation.

state.description: Current state of the refinance operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the refinance operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Any informational message related to the refinance operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the refinance operation API. Contains the status, reference number, and various metadata about the operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains metadata about the creation and processing of the refinance operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds that the request took to process. A lower value signifies a faster response.
